scripts.features:
This script is an all-in-one automation tool designed to completely dominate Military Tycoon without manual grinding.

If it doesn't find a control point, make sure to click Refresh Control Points. Or Refresh Conquest Outposts button. Since if a new player takes over a post, it needs to refresh their names. I have kept auto refresh of points off so that the script can run faster.

🎯 1. Smart Auto Aim & Combat

The script features a highly optimized combat assist system designed to work seamlessly with the game's built-in mechanics.

Camera-Based Auto Aim: Snaps your camera directly to the nearest enemy (NPC soldiers or players) when capturing a zone. It forces your character to look exactly where they need to.

Auto Reload: Automatically simulates pressing the R key during combat so you never get caught with an empty magazine.

IMPORTANT SETUP: The script handles the aiming, but not the shooting. You must enable the "Auto Fire" setting in the game's menu. Additionally, you must turn OFF the game's built-in "Aim Assist" and "Third Person Aim Tilt" OFF so it doesn't fight against the script's precise camera snapping.

🚁 2. Advanced Auto Conquest

Automate the takeover of the entire map. You can toggle between different target types, and the script handles the rest.

Outposts, Armed Outposts, & Strongholds: Dedicated loops for each type of base.

Distance-Based Mapping: Calculates the distance of all targets and always goes to the closest one first to save time.

Smart Filtering: Automatically detects and skips bases you already own to prevent wasting time.

Safe Teleportation (NoClip Tweening): Bypasses the game's anti-cheat by smoothly tweening your character through the air (with NoClip enabled). Once it arrives, it instantly zeroes out your momentum so you don't glitch through the floor.

Hover Capture: Hovers exactly 10 studs above the capture flag to keep you out of immediate crossfire while the capture bar fills.

Conflict Resolution: If you switch from capturing Outposts to Strongholds, the script instantly and safely self-destructs the old task and seamlessly pivots to the new one without breaking the game.

💰 3. Auto Farming & Collection

Auto Collect Cash: Periodically teleports you back to your Tycoon's bank to collect your money, then resumes whatever you were doing.

Auto Collect Crates: Scans the entire map for airdrops and loot crates, flying you to them instantly.

Collect Parts & Medals: Sweeps the map for event parts and medals so you don't have to hunt for them manually.

🏃‍♂️ 4. Local Player Enhancements

Speed & Jump Modifiers: Manually override your WalkSpeed and JumpPower to zoom across the map.

Infinite Jump: Hop endlessly in the air to avoid enemy fire.

ESP System (Wallhack): See exactly where Players, Vehicles, and Crates are through walls so you are never caught off guard.

🛡️ 5. Safety & Anti-Glitch Systems

Mutual Exclusion System: It is mathematically impossible for two Auto-Conquest or Auto-Farm loops to run at the same time. If you turn on Auto Farm while Auto Conquest is running, the script safely pauses the conquest to farm, then resumes.

Death Detection: Automatically pauses tweens and waits for your character to fully respawn if you happen to die in combat.

local function createInstance(className, properties, children)
    local instance = Instance.new(className)
    for property, value in pairs(properties or {}) do
        instance[property] = value
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(children or {}) do
        child.Parent = instance
    end
    return instance
end

local function makeDraggable(frame, connectionTable)
    local isDragging = false
    local dragStart = nil
    local frameStart = nil
    local inputChangedConnection = nil

    local inputBeganConnection = frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            isDragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            frameStart = frame.Position

            local stateChangedConnection = input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    isDragging = false
                    if stateChangedConnection then
                        stateChangedConnection:Disconnect()
                    end
                end
            end)

            if connectionTable then
                table.insert(connectionTable, stateChangedConnection)
            end
        end
    end)

    local inputChangedConnection2 = frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            inputChangedConnection = input
        end
    end)

    local globalInputConnection = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == inputChangedConnection and isDragging then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(
                frameStart.X.Scale,
                frameStart.X.Offset + delta.X,
                frameStart.Y.Scale,
                frameStart.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)

    if connectionTable then
        table.insert(connectionTable, inputBeganConnection)
        table.insert(connectionTable, inputChangedConnection2)
        table.insert(connectionTable, globalInputConnection)

function PacketBlocker:recordPacket(packetId)
    if not packetId or not self.packetCounts then
        return

    local count = self.packetCounts[packetId]

    if self.logEntries[packetId] then

end

function PacketBlocker:previousPacket()
    self:selectPacket((self.selectedPacket - 1 + 256) % 256)
end

function PacketBlocker:toggleBlock()

    if self.isBlocking then
        self.toggleButton.Text = "Unblock " .. (BlockKey~="" and ("(%s)"):format(BlockKey)) or ""
        self:setButtonColor(self.toggleButton, Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 67))
    else
        self.toggleButton.Text = "Block " .. (BlockKey~="" and ("(%s)"):format(BlockKey)) or ""
        self:setButtonColor(self.toggleButton, Color3.fromRGB(220, 50, 50))
    end

    self:updateStatus()
end

function PacketBlocker:applyPacket()
    local inputText = self.packetInput.Text
    local hexMatch = inputText:match("0x([%da-fA-F]+)") or inputText:match("([%da-fA-F]+)")
    local packetId = hexMatch and tonumber(hexMatch, 16)

    if packetId and packetId >= 0 and packetId <= 255 then
        self:selectPacket(packetId)
    else
        self.statusLabel.Text = "Status: Invalid ID (0x00 - 0xFF)"
        self.statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 100)
    end
end

function PacketBlocker:updateDisplay()
    self.packetDisplay.Text = string.format("Selected Packet: 0x%02X", self.selectedPacket)
end

function PacketBlocker:updateStatus()
    if self.isBlocking then
        self.statusLabel.Text = string.format("Blocking 0x%02X | Blocked: %d", self.selectedPacket, self.blockedCount)
        self.statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
    else
        self.statusLabel.Text = string.format("Status: Idle (0x%02X)", self.selectedPacket)
        self.statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
    end
end

function PacketBlocker:registerHooks()
    local raknetLibrary = raknet or (getgenv and getgenv().raknet) or (_G and _G.raknet)

    if raknetLibrary and typeof(raknetLibrary.add_send_hook) == "function" then
        self.activeHook = function(packet)
            if not self or not self.screenGui then
                return
            end

            if packet and packet.PacketId then
                if self.isBlocking and packet.PacketId == self.selectedPacket then
                    if typeof(packet.Block) == "function" then
                        packet:Block()
                    end
                    self.blockedCount = self.blockedCount + 1
                    self:updateStatus()
                    return
                end

                self:recordPacket(packet.PacketId)
            end
        end

        raknetLibrary.add_send_hook(self.activeHook)
        self.statusLabel.Text = "Status: RakNet Hook Active"
        self.statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
    else
        self.statusLabel.Text = "Status: RakNet Library Not Found"
        self.statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
    end
end

function PacketBlocker:toggle()
    self.screenGui.Enabled = not self.screenGui.Enabled
end

function PacketBlocker:destroy()
    self.isBlocking = false

    local raknetLibrary = raknet or (getgenv and getgenv().raknet) or (_G and _G.raknet)
    if raknetLibrary and typeof(raknetLibrary.remove_send_hook) == "function" and self.activeHook then
        pcall(function()
            raknetLibrary.remove_send_hook(self.activeHook)
        end)
    end

    self.activeHook = nil

    if self.connections then
        for _, connection in ipairs(self.connections) do
            if connection and connection.Connected then
                connection:Disconnect()
            end
        end
        table.clear(self.connections)
        self.connections = nil
    end

    if self.logEntries then
        for _, entry in pairs(self.logEntries) do
            if entry then
                entry:Destroy()
            end
        end
        table.clear(self.logEntries)
        self.logEntries = nil
    end

    if self.logWindow then
        self.logWindow:Destroy()
        self.logWindow = nil
    end

    if self.screenGui then
        self.screenGui:Destroy()
        self.screenGui = nil
    end

    if self.packetCounts then
        table.clear(self.packetCounts)
        self.packetCounts = nil
    end

    setmetatable(self, nil)
end

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local GENV = getgenv()

local State = {
	InfiniteStamina = false,
	InfiniteAmmo = false,
	Running = true,

	Guns = {},
	GunConnections = {},
	Connections = {},
	StaminaConnections = {},

	OriginalMaxStamina = nil
}

GENV.AnomalyLockdown = State

local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
	Name = "Anomaly Lockdown",
	Icon = 0,

	LoadingTitle = "Anomaly Lockdown",
	LoadingSubtitle = "Utilities",

	ShowText = "Anomaly Lockdown",

	Theme = "Default",

	ToggleUIKeybind = "K",

	DisableRayfieldPrompts = false,
	DisableBuildWarnings = false,

	ConfigurationSaving = {
		Enabled = false,
		FolderName = nil,
		FileName = "AnomalyLockdown"
	},

	Discord = {
		Enabled = false,
		Invite = "",
		RememberJoins = false
	},

	KeySystem = false
})

local Main = Window:CreateTab("Main", 4483362458)
local Extras = Window:CreateTab("Extras", 4483362458)

local function DisconnectList(List)
	for _, Connection in ipairs(List) do
		pcall(function()
			Connection:Disconnect()
		end)
	end

	table.clear(List)
end

local function GetPlayerData()
	return Player:FindFirstChild("PlayerData")
end

local function GetStaminaValues()
	local PlayerData = GetPlayerData()

	if not PlayerData then
		return nil, nil
	end

	return
		PlayerData:FindFirstChild("MaxStamina"),
		PlayerData:FindFirstChild("Stamina")
end

local function ForceStamina()
	if not State.InfiniteStamina then
		return
	end

	local MaxStamina, Stamina = GetStaminaValues()

	if not MaxStamina or not Stamina then
		return
	end

	pcall(function()
		if MaxStamina.Value ~= 999999 then
			MaxStamina.Value = 999999
		end

		if Stamina.Value ~= 999999 then
			Stamina.Value = 999999
		end
	end)
end

local function SetupStaminaWatch()
	DisconnectList(State.StaminaConnections)

	local MaxStamina, Stamina = GetStaminaValues()

	if not MaxStamina or not Stamina then
		return false
	end

	if State.OriginalMaxStamina == nil then
		State.OriginalMaxStamina = MaxStamina.Value
	end

	table.insert(
		State.StaminaConnections,
		MaxStamina:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
			if State.InfiniteStamina and MaxStamina.Value ~= 999999 then
				MaxStamina.Value = 999999
			end
		end)
	)

	table.insert(
		State.StaminaConnections,
		Stamina:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
			if State.InfiniteStamina and Stamina.Value ~= 999999 then
				Stamina.Value = 999999
			end
		end)
	)

	ForceStamina()

	return true
end

local function DisableStamina()
	DisconnectList(State.StaminaConnections)

	local MaxStamina, Stamina = GetStaminaValues()

	if MaxStamina and State.OriginalMaxStamina ~= nil then
		pcall(function()
			MaxStamina.Value = State.OriginalMaxStamina
		end)
	end

	if Stamina and MaxStamina then
		pcall(function()
			if Stamina.Value > MaxStamina.Value then
				Stamina.Value = MaxStamina.Value
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function IsGunConfig(Object)
	if not Object then
		return false
	end

	if Object.Name ~= "GunConfigs" then
		return false
	end

	return Object:FindFirstChild("Ammo") ~= nil
		or Object:FindFirstChild("Clip") ~= nil
end

local function IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Object)
	if not Object then
		return false
	end

	local Backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local Character = Player.Character

	if Backpack and Object:IsDescendantOf(Backpack) then
		return true
	end

	if Character and Object:IsDescendantOf(Character) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

local function FindMaxValues(Config)
	local MaxAmmo
	local MaxClip

	local AmmoConfigs = Config:FindFirstChild("AmmoConfigs")

	if AmmoConfigs then
		MaxAmmo = AmmoConfigs:FindFirstChild("MaxAmmo", true)
		MaxClip = AmmoConfigs:FindFirstChild("MaxClip", true)
	end

	return MaxAmmo, MaxClip
end

local function FillGun(Config)
	if not State.InfiniteAmmo then
		return
	end

	if not Config or not Config.Parent then
		return
	end

	if not IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Config) then
		return
	end

	local Ammo = Config:FindFirstChild("Ammo")
	local Clip = Config:FindFirstChild("Clip")

	local MaxAmmo, MaxClip = FindMaxValues(Config)

	pcall(function()
		if MaxAmmo and MaxAmmo.Value ~= 999999 then
			MaxAmmo.Value = 999999
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if MaxClip and MaxClip.Value ~= 999999 then
			MaxClip.Value = 999999
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if Ammo and Ammo.Value ~= 999999 then
			Ammo.Value = 999999
		end
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if Clip and Clip.Value ~= 999999 then
			Clip.Value = 999999
		end
	end)
end

local function RemoveGun(Config)
	State.Guns[Config] = nil

	local Connections = State.GunConnections[Config]

	if Connections then
		DisconnectList(Connections)
		State.GunConnections[Config] = nil
	end
end

local function RegisterGun(Config)
	if not IsGunConfig(Config) then
		return
	end

	if State.Guns[Config] then
		if State.InfiniteAmmo then
			FillGun(Config)
		end

		return
	end

	State.Guns[Config] = true
	State.GunConnections[Config] = {}

	local Connections = State.GunConnections[Config]

	local Ammo = Config:FindFirstChild("Ammo")
	local Clip = Config:FindFirstChild("Clip")
	local MaxAmmo, MaxClip = FindMaxValues(Config)

	local function WatchValue(ValueObject)
		if not ValueObject then
			return
		end

		table.insert(
			Connections,
			ValueObject:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
				if State.InfiniteAmmo then
					FillGun(Config)
				end
			end)
		)
	end

	WatchValue(Ammo)
	WatchValue(Clip)
	WatchValue(MaxAmmo)
	WatchValue(MaxClip)

	table.insert(
		Connections,
		Config.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
			task.delay(0.15, function()
				if not State.Running then
					return
				end

				if not Config.Parent then
					RemoveGun(Config)
					return
				end

				if not IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Config) then
					RemoveGun(Config)
				end
			end)
		end)
	)

	if State.InfiniteAmmo then
		FillGun(Config)
	end
end

local function RegisterTool(Tool)
	if not Tool then
		return
	end

	local Config = Tool:FindFirstChild("GunConfigs")

	if Config and IsGunConfig(Config) then
		RegisterGun(Config)
		return
	end

	for _, Object in ipairs(Tool:GetChildren()) do
		if IsGunConfig(Object) then
			RegisterGun(Object)
			return
		end
	end

	local DescendantConnection

	DescendantConnection = Tool.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(Object)
		if IsGunConfig(Object) then
			RegisterGun(Object)

			if DescendantConnection then
				DescendantConnection:Disconnect()
				DescendantConnection = nil
			end
		end
	end)

	task.delay(5, function()
		if DescendantConnection then
			DescendantConnection:Disconnect()
			DescendantConnection = nil
		end
	end)
end

local function ScanContainerOnce(Container)
	if not Container then
		return
	end

	for _, Object in ipairs(Container:GetChildren()) do
		RegisterTool(Object)
	end
end

local function ScanCurrentGuns()
	local Backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local Character = Player.Character

	ScanContainerOnce(Backpack)
	ScanContainerOnce(Character)
end

local function CountGuns()
	local Count = 0

	for Config in pairs(State.Guns) do
		if Config
			and Config.Parent
			and IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Config)
		then
			Count += 1
		end
	end

	return Count
end

local function FillAllGuns()
	if not State.InfiniteAmmo then
		return
	end

	for Config in pairs(State.Guns) do
		if Config
			and Config.Parent
			and IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Config)
		then
			FillGun(Config)
		end
	end
end

local function IsLoseClipRemote(Object)
	if typeof(Object) ~= "Instance" then
		return false
	end

	if Object.Name ~= "LoseClip" then
		return false
	end

	if not IsOwnedByLocalPlayer(Object) then
		return false
	end

	local Current = Object.Parent

	while Current do
		if Current.Name == "ServerMain" then
			return true
		end

		Current = Current.Parent
	end

	return false
end

if type(hookmetamethod) == "function"
	and type(getnamecallmethod) == "function"
	and type(newcclosure) == "function"
then

	local OldNamecall

	OldNamecall = hookmetamethod(
		game,
		"__namecall",
		newcclosure(function(Self, ...)
			local Method = getnamecallmethod()

			if State.InfiniteAmmo
				and (
					Method == "FireServer"
					or Method == "InvokeServer"
				)
				and IsLoseClipRemote(Self)
			then
				return nil
			end

			return OldNamecall(Self, ...)
		end)
	)
end

local WatchedContainers = {}

local function WatchContainer(Container)
	if not Container then
		return
	end

	if WatchedContainers[Container] then
		return
	end

	WatchedContainers[Container] = true

	ScanContainerOnce(Container)

	local AddedConnection = Container.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Object)
		task.defer(function()
			RegisterTool(Object)
		end)
	end)

	local RemovedConnection = Container.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(Object)
		task.delay(0.15, function()
			if Object.Parent then
				return
			end

			for Config in pairs(State.Guns) do
				if Config
					and (
						Config == Object
						or Config:IsDescendantOf(Object)
					)
				then
					RemoveGun(Config)
				end
			end
		end)
	end)

	table.insert(State.Connections, AddedConnection)
	table.insert(State.Connections, RemovedConnection)
end

local function SetupPlayerWatchers()
	local Backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")

	if Backpack then
		WatchContainer(Backpack)
	end

	if Player.Character then
		WatchContainer(Player.Character)
	end

	table.insert(
		State.Connections,
		Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(Character)
			task.wait(0.15)

			WatchContainer(Character)

			if State.InfiniteStamina then
				SetupStaminaWatch()
			end

			if State.InfiniteAmmo then
				ScanCurrentGuns()
				FillAllGuns()
			end
		end)
	)

	table.insert(
		State.Connections,
		Player.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Object)
			if Object:IsA("Backpack") then
				task.defer(function()
					WatchContainer(Object)

					if State.InfiniteAmmo then
						ScanCurrentGuns()
						FillAllGuns()
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
	)
end
